# Introducing the PS5 Input System package

The PS5 Input System package provides support for the unique features of the DualSense controller for PlayStation®5 (PS5). The package opens access to the following DualSense features:

* Trigger effects
* Vibration
* Touchpad
* Motion sensor
* Light bar

If you are using the [Unity Input System](https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.inputsystem@latest) package with your project, you must use this package to access the features of the DualSense controller on PS5. The Unity Input System package will automatically install as part of the PS5 input package installation process.

The package contains a sample scene titled **Multi Controller PS5 Input samples** that gives examples of how to interact with the DualSense features in the package. For more information, refer to [Use the Sample project](sample-project.md).

To get started, follow the [Getting started with the PS5 Input System package](getting-started.md) guide and information on the [features of the DualSense® Wireless Controller](dualsense-features.md).
